entities.name: Bojan Janić
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Bojan Janić is a Serbian volleyball player and former captain of the Serbia national team. He was a member of the national team at the 2008 Summer Olympics in Beijing and 2012 Summer Olympics in London.
